_about: MeatCODE Ecosystem data snapshot. people/papers: Neon read-only SELECT on 2026-10-08 (authors of sources with relevance_llm >= 60 matched to public.experts by exact normalised name; 153 people, 108 papers). inbox: MeatCODE DB Agent Inbox (Google Sheet), run 2026-10-07; only rows a person set to Approved or Merged are shown to users. Sanitised: no emails, notes, scores on people, or agent-suggested LinkedIn/ResearchGate links. Replace this file (same shape) to refresh; a live /api endpoint is the planned successor.

papers.t: Improving the flavor of protein hydrolysates from shrimp processing byproducts via maillard reaction: Towards structure-flavor rel…

papers.t: Glycation modification of protein hydrolysate from channel catfish (Ictalurus Punetaus) viscera to mitigate undesirable flavor

papers.c: Peptide structural features and external factors determine volatile aroma yield and specificity in Maillard reactions, particularly for pyrazines.

papers.t: Mechanism of pyrazines and thioethers formation promoted by high oxygen concentration in the methionine‐glucose Maillard reaction

papers.c: Amadori rearrangement products are key Maillard intermediates with potential to replicate meat-like flavor in plant-based meat analogs.

papers.t: Early reaction pathways in a glucose-glutathione Maillard system to form meat flavor

papers.t: The Aroma of Non-Fermented and Fermented Dry-Cured Meat Products: Savory and Toasted Odors

papers.t: Characteristic volatile compounds contributed to aroma of braised pork and their precursor sources

papers.t: Flavoromics of meats as a function of postmortem proteolysis

papers.t: Effects of intramuscular fat on the flavor of fresh sheep and goat meat: Recent insights into pre-mortem and post-mortem factors

papers.t: The co‐fermentation of Actinomucor elegans and Monascus purpureus for the production of meat flavor with soybean protein
papers.c: Co-fermentation followed by Maillard reaction produces meat flavor essence from soybean protein.

papers.t: Multi-omics analysis reveals the differences in meat quality and flavor among three breeds of white goats

papers.t: Revealing the characteristic aroma and boundary compositions of five pig breeds based on HS-SPME/GC-O-MS and aroma recombination

papers.t: Characterization and discrimination of lamb with different breeds and muscle types using precursors and volatile compounds
papers.c: Volatile compounds and aroma precursors vary by lamb breed and muscle type.

papers.t: Effect of Boiling Time on the Color, Water, Protein Secondary Structure, and Volatile Compounds of Beef
papers.c: Boiling time affects beef color, water distribution, protein structure and volatile concentration.

papers.t: Effect of alterations in phospholipids and free fatty acids on aroma-active compounds in instant-boiled beef cuts
papers.c: Lipid composition and phospholipid profiles influence aroma-active volatiles in different beef cuts after instant-boiling.

papers.t: Relationship between phospholipid molecules species and volatile compounds in grilled lambs during the heating process
papers.c: Nineteen key volatiles and 142 phospholipid molecules identified in grilled lamb.

papers.t: Chemical and sensory analyses of cultivated pork fat tissue as a flavor enhancer for meat alternatives
papers.c: Cell-cultivated porcine adipose tissue can enhance the sensory and aromatic profile of meat alternative products.

papers.t: Why Does Braising Enhance the Aroma Profile of Xinjiang Braised–Roasted Chicken? Precursor Conversion and Aroma Formation
papers.c: Braising then roasting enhances aroma complexity in chicken through precursor conversion and multiple formation pathways.

papers.t: A comprehensive analysis of aroma quality and perception mechanism in ginger-infused stewed beef
papers.c: Ginger infusion decreases C6–C10 aldehydes and increases terpenes in stewed beef, improving perception.

papers.t: Identification and comparison of aroma and taste-related compounds from breast meat of three breeds of Korean native chickens
papers.c: Korean native chicken breeds differ in taste-related compounds and aroma volatiles.

papers.t: Flavoromics Analysis of Passion Fruit-Roasted Chicken
papers.c: Ethyl butyrate is the dominant characteristic flavor compound in passion fruit-roasted chicken.

papers.t: Characterization of aroma release and perception during ginger-infused stewed beef oral processing
papers.c: Ginger infusion enhances meaty and fatty aroma attributes in stewed beef during oral processing.

papers.t: Research on maillard derived aroma and precursors in different types of pork based on metabolomics
papers.c: High-temperature processing of indigenous pork breeds produces Maillard-derived aroma compounds linked to specific precursors.

papers.t: Characterization of Key Aroma Compounds in Dongpo Pork Dish and Their Dynamic Changes During Storage
papers.c: Key aroma compounds in Dongpo pork identified and tracked during storage.

papers.t: Characterization of key aroma-active components in roast mutton: GC-IMS, GC–MS and aroma recombination
papers.c: Multi-technique analysis identifies key aroma-active compounds in roasted lamb.

papers.t: Lipidomics in chicken meat flavor chemistry: Current understanding, integrated omics approaches, and future perspectives
papers.c: Lipidomics reveals mechanisms of lipid oxidation, Maillard reaction and thiamine degradation in chicken flavor.

papers.t: Influence of processing points on the flavor of meat balls braised with brown sauce

papers.t: Characterization of key aromas in different breeds of pork based on molecular sensory science and computational chemistry

papers.t: Difference comparison of characteristic aroma compounds between braised pork cooked by traditional open-fire and induction cooker

papers.t: Role of lipids in beef flavor development: A review of research from the past 20 years

papers.t: Main lipid sources affecting key aroma volatile compounds in Chinese native chicken

papers.t: Exploring potential lipid precursors for aroma formation in non-smoked bacon during hot air drying via untargeted lipidomics
papers.c: Hot air drying of bacon increases free fatty acids and lysophospholipids; specific triglycerides identified as precursors.

papers.t: The content- and odor-advantaged volatile compounds and the characteristic odor profile of n-3 PUFA-rich fried pork

papers.t: Mechanism of salt effect on flavor formation in Lactiplantibacillus plantarum fermented tilapia

papers.t: Quality characteristics and volatile profiles of giant salamander (Andrias davidianus) meat during the air frying process

papers.t: Controlled formation of characteristic aroma compounds induced by added seasonings during electromagnetic cooking of braised pork

papers.t: Signature aroma compounds and precursors in Chinese indigenous pork: OAV-weighted GC-O-MS and lipidomic profiling

papers.t: Minimizing spice usage while retaining flavor signatures of spiced pork via integrative flavoromics and sensory evaluation

papers.t: Visualization of differential aroma profiles of Beijing and Nanjing roast duck by sensomics methodology

papers.t: Insights into the flavor endowment of aroma-active compounds in cloves (Syzygium aromaticum) to stewed beef

papers.t: Exploring the regulation of metabolic changes mediated by different combined starter cultures on flavor of fermented sausages

papers.t: Upscaling fermentation of onion by Laetiporus sulphureus: Process optimization, aroma characterization, and application in plant-based meat

papers.t: Ultrasound-induced modifications of beef flavor characteristics during postmortem aging
papers.c: Ultrasound treatment enhances beef flavor during postmortem aging by modifying volatile formation pathways.

papers.t: Variation of volatile flavor substances in salt-baked chicken during processing

papers.t: Development of Volatile Compounds in Raw Fermented Sausages with Reduced Nitrogen Compounds—The Effect of Tomato Pomace
papers.c: Tomato pomace in reduced-nitrite fermented sausages modulates volatile profiles and sensory characteristics.

papers.t: Identification of volatile flavor substances in four key muscle portions of five Tibetan sheep breeds
papers.c: HS-SPME-GC-MS and GC-IMS characterize volatiles across five Tibetan sheep breeds and muscle portions.

papers.t: Mechanistic insights into off-flavor masking of textured soy protein using a Maillard reaction system with D-xylose and sulfur-containing amino acids

papers.t: Mechanisms underlying tomato-mediated suppression of warmed-over flavor (WOF) and flavor enrichment in precooked stewed beef

papers.t: Ingredient-driven mitigation of warmed-over flavor by Chinese star anise in precooked Chinese stewed beef

papers.t: Influences of thioalcohols on the release of aromas in sesame-flavor baijiu
papers.c: Thioalcohols interact with aroma-active compounds in sesame-flavor baijiu.

papers.t: Evaluation of perceptual interactions between key aldehydes in Kung Pao Chicken

papers.t: Study on Interaction of Aromatic Substances and Electroencephalogram Correlates of Odor Perception in Light-Flavor Baijiu
papers.c: β-damascenone interactions with esters and alcohols are promotive while interactions with acids are masking.

papers.t: Mechanism of flavor enhancement by yeast extract and clam extract in ginger-surimi cake: flavoromics and machine learning
papers.c: Yeast extract promotes Strecker degradation of branched amino acids into key aroma aldehydes.

papers.t: Changes in flavor profile of sauce-flavor baijiu: Perceptual interactions between 1-propanol and aroma compounds
papers.c: 1-Propanol in sauce-flavor baijiu diminishes floral and fruity notes.

papers.t: Relationship between sulfur compounds and Baijiu flavor: composition, flavor characteristics, and modulation
papers.c: Trace sulfur compounds are crucial to baijiu aroma due to their low odor thresholds.

papers.t: Competitive binding of flavors in the preparation of soy protein: Screening based on molecular docking

papers.c: Yeast extract masks warmed-over flavor in surimi gels through high concentrations of pyrazines and esters.

papers.c: Odorant masking between 2,3,5-trimethylpyrazine and l-menthol is mediated by specific olfactory receptors.

papers.t: Characterization of odor profiles of pea milk varieties and identification of key odor-active compounds
papers.c: Pea milk shows lower beany and oil-oxidation notes but higher grassy and earthy notes than soybean milk.

papers.t: Characterization of off-flavor compounds in ready-to-heat roasted catfish after reheating by sensomics approach
papers.c: Sensomics identifies 19 off-flavor compounds in reheated roasted catfish.

papers.t: Identification of the key aroma compounds in flaxseed milk using stir bar sorptive extraction, aroma recombination and omission
papers.c: Stir bar sorptive extraction identifies 13 key aroma compounds in flaxseed milk.

papers.t: Technological challenges and future perspectives of plant-based meat analogues: From the viewpoint of proteins
papers.c: Plant-based meat analogues face challenges replicating meat texture, flavor, color and nutrition.

papers.t: Pea protein: Advances in applications, protein-flavor interactions, and flavor enhancement strategies
papers.c: Pea protein for plant-based meat requires flavor enhancement strategies to address off-notes.

papers.c: Pre-heating reduces beany flavor and improves oxidative stability in pea milk powder.

papers.c: Catechins and Duralox mitigate beany off-flavor in pea protein by reducing lipid oxidation.

papers.t: Screening of a Microbial Culture Collection: Selection of Starters for Enhanced Sensory Attributes of Pea-Protein-Based Beverages

papers.t: Fermentation by lactic acid bacteria during pea protein isolation reduces undesirable flavors and changes techno-functional properties
papers.c: Lactic acid fermentation during pea protein isolation reduces undesirable flavors.

papers.c: Radio frequency pretreatment inactivates lipoxygenase to mitigate beany off-flavors in pea protein isolate.

papers.c: Lactococcus lactis rapidly acidifies pea protein and reduces off-flavor compounds like hexanal.

papers.c: Lactic acid bacteria and yeasts remove off-flavors from plant protein ingredients through non-growing bioconversion.

papers.c: L. johnsonii fermentation of a pea protein beverage generates six umami and kokumi-enhancing peptides while reducing bitterness.

papers.c: Lactic acid bacteria selection improves flavor in hybrid plant-dairy cheese.

papers.t: Comparison of volatile compound profiles derived from various livestock protein alternatives including edible-insect and plant-based proteins
papers.c: Edible insects show distinct volatile profiles; plant-based proteins show high pyrazine and furan content.

papers.t: Perceptual interactions of key aroma compounds in Fu brick tea: Odor threshold, sensory, and E-nose analysis
papers.c: Perceptual interactions of key aroma compounds in Fu brick tea.

papers.t: Characterization and correlations of dominant microorganisms and volatile compounds in fermentation of Yangjiang douchi
papers.c: Microorganisms drive volatile development across fermentation stages in Yangjiang douchi.

papers.t: Development of a Liquid Microbial Enzyme Synergistic Fermentation Process for Fresh Distiller’s Grains
papers.c: Microbial-enzyme fermentation enhances nutritional value and aroma of distiller's grains.

papers.t: Elucidating the Impact of High-Temperature Daqu on Base Baijiu of Sauce-Flavor Baijiu
papers.c: High-temperature Daqu contributes floral-fruity and roasted notes to sauce-flavor baijiu.

papers.t: Dynamic changes in dissolved oxygen, microbial communities, and volatile compounds during industrial oak-barrel fermentation
papers.c: Oak-barrel fermentation alters microbial communities and volatile formation in white wine.

papers.t: Effect of co‐inoculations of Saccharomyces cerevisiae and grape endophytes on fermentation and volatile aroma
papers.c: Co-inoculation of S. cerevisiae with grape endophytic fungi enhances fermentation rate and volatile aroma.
